scope: reporting only; the extractor, the counter, the corpus, the strata, and the hypotheses are unchanged
observation: the summary converted linearization counts to floats for the quartiles; a proof of 291 steps with structure index 0.665 has about 10^394 linearizations, beyond the float range, so the run would have failed after writing the extraction and the results
change: quartiles of the counts are computed in integer arithmetic (the value at rank p*(n-1), or the midpoint of the two neighbouring ranks rounded down, which decides `median >= 10` exactly) and stored as decimal strings; the report prints counts above seven digits in scientific notation; the per-stratum number of declarations with more than one root is added as a descriptive column
disclosure: the changed summary was exercised on the counts of the 306-declaration validation sample of amendment 2; that table and its H10/H11 verdicts were seen (H10 held on the sample, H11 did not in its 51+ stratum). No hypothesis, threshold, or stratum is changed; the corpus run reports whatever it finds.
